title: Bois Caiman ceremony launches the Haitian Revolution
summary: Enslaved people of northern Saint-Domingue gathered at Bois Caiman for a Vodou ceremony led by Dutty Boukman, where they planned a revolt. The uprising broke out a week later.
reason: Brutal plantation slavery and news of revolutionary ideals from France fuelled the plot.
significance: It began the only successful slave revolution in history.
